title: PetPace Vitals Failure Rate
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder cam detections, plant/soil sensors (`plant:sensor`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petpace:vitals
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(vitals_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by pet_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often PetPace vitals records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each pet.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize vitals_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per pet.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It calmly which parts of your PetPace vitals data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
